title: While Amazon blocks AI agents, Walmart rolls out the welcome mat | TechCrunch
summary: The Agent Profiles will be created the first time you use a given agent to shop through the Walmart Agent Gateway, the company notes. Agent support is available for anyone with a Walmart account; a Walmart+ membership is not necessary.
